interpretation: The guide distinguishes direct providers, protocol and conceptual references, and development tools. Component applicability requires code evidence; catalog membership is not integration.

components.name: links-notation
components.finding: Both packages declare 0.22.0 and provide linked grammar/network text projections.

components.name: link-cli
components.finding: Query and substitution conventions are adapted in-process. Neither runtime manifest declares link-cli. Full dynamic CST and formal-concept interchange is not established by these adapters.

components.name: doublets-rs

components.name: doublets-web

components.name: link-calculator

components.name: lino-i18n

components.name: relative-meta-logic

components.name: meta-theory

components.name: Agent CLI and Hive Mind
components.finding: Development orchestration is distinct from shipped semantic and parser providers.

representationGaps.finding: Concept records currently contain English definition strings and metadata. These do not establish recursively formal linked meaning or a semantic equivalence proof.
Interned typed points use the existing unary self-reference representation. The explicitly requested self-loop doublet and its faithful projections must be represented under a declared link model.
Existing storage serialization alone does not prove source-free recreation of all CST, formal definitions, certificates and extension rules through link-cli and text/binary Links Notation.

theoryBoundaries: Archived English article 0.0.2 and draft 0.0.3 are distinct source revisions.
Recursive and cyclic link definitions do not by themselves prove universal consistency or arbitrary program equivalence.
The physical wave/fractal analogy is captured as user motivation and a hypothesis, not implementation or scientific proof.
The structural foundation does not install universal self-typing, one truth model, or a consumer proof authority.
